create.title: Record EFD number
create.intro: Enter the receipt number printed by the EFD device for a confirmed order. The amount and VAT are copied from the order.

list.title: Z reports
list.subtitle: The end-of-day fiscal report printed by each EFD device. Record the figures from the printout; another person verifies them.
list.search: Search report no or Z number
list.emptyFiltered: No Z reports match your filters.
list.emptyNone: No Z reports recorded yet. Use “Record Z Report” at the end of the trading day.

actions.voidPrompt: Reason for voiding {{no}}? This cannot be undone.

form.deviceLocked: The device cannot be changed. Void this report and record a new one if it was recorded on the wrong device.
form.zNumberTitle: Digits only (the Z number printed by the device)
form.vatTooBig: VAT cannot be more than the gross amount.
form.net: Net amount (gross − VAT, calculated by the server):

create.title: Record Z report
create.sub: Copy the figures from the Z report printed by the EFD device. There can be one live report per device per day.
create.vatError: VAT cannot be more than the gross amount
create.saved: Z report recorded. It now waits for verification.

update.title: Edit Z report
update.locked: This Z report is {{status}} and can no longer be edited.
update.notMine: Only the person who recorded this Z report can edit it.

view.title: Z report {{no}}
view.compareHelp: What the device printed, against the EFD receipts the system recorded for the same device and day. Check any difference before verifying.

figures.unreceipted: Confirmed orders without an EFD receipt

list.title: Daily reconciliation
list.subtitle: For one EFD device and one day, the Z report is compared with the EFD receipts recorded in the system. A day is closed once another person signs it off.
list.emptyNone: No reconciliations yet. Record the day’s Z report, then use “Start Reconciliation”.

actions.refreshed: Figures refreshed from the Z report and the receipts.
actions.signConfirm: Sign off {{no}}? The figures match, so {{day}} will be closed for this device.
actions.signPrompt: {{no}} has a difference. Explain it (at least 10 characters) to sign off {{day}}:
actions.voidReopen: The day will open again for receipts.

create.title: Start reconciliation
create.sub: Choose the EFD device and the day. The figures below are calculated by the server and are only saved when you start.
create.noZ: There is no Z report for {{device}} on {{date}} yet.
create.existing: This device already has reconciliation <l>{{no}}</l> for this day ({{status}}). Void it first to start again.
create.zNotVerified: The Z report is not verified yet. You can start the reconciliation, but it can only be signed off after another person verifies the Z report.
create.hasDifference: There is a difference. To sign off this day, the person who signs it off must write an explanation.
create.started: Reconciliation started. Another person can now review it and sign it off.

view.title: Reconciliation {{no}}
view.compareHelp: Difference = Z report minus the EFD receipts recorded in the system for this device and day. These figures are a snapshot; use Refresh while the reconciliation is open to re-read them.
view.diffBanner: This day has a difference. Check the receipts below before signing off.
view.diffBannerUnreceipted: This day has a difference and confirmed orders without an EFD receipt. Check the receipts below before signing off.
view.zNotVerified: The Z report is {{status}}. It must be verified by another person before this day can be reconciled.
view.mine: You started this reconciliation, so someone else must sign it off.
view.explanationPlaceholder: Why do the Z report and the system differ?
view.explanationError: Explain the difference in at least 10 characters
view.matchNote: The figures match. Signing off closes this day for the device: receipts for it cannot be recorded or voided until the reconciliation is voided.
view.noPermission: You do not have permission to sign off reconciliations.
view.signed: Day reconciled. Receipts for this device and day are now closed.
view.receiptsHelp: The EFD receipts recorded on this device that day{{limit}}.
view.noReceipts: No EFD receipts were recorded for this device on this day.
